newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson boards to meet Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Thomson boards to meet Tuesday.

text.p: The boards of French defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF and its state-owned parent Thomson SA will meet on Tuesday morning to discuss the privatisation of Thomson-CSF, a company spokesman said.
"An update on the privatisation is expected to be on the agenda," a spokesman for the group said on Monday.

A finance ministry spokesman would only say that the independent Privatisation Commission's opinion on the government's terms and conditions of sale would be published in the Official Journal in the next few days.
The publication of the opinion, if it approves the terms and conditions - "cahier des charges" - effectively launches the privatisation process.

This stage allows the potential bidders, Lagardere Groupe and Alcatel Alsthom, to announce officially their candidacy for Thomson-CSF. Alcatel has allied itself with Dassault Aviation and Aerospatiale to bid for Thomson-CSF.
